import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,base64,sys
from pathlib import Path
r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f','3','-l','3','-scale-to','1300','-singlefile','-png','sources/cycle-public.pdf'],capture_output=True,check=True)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'sources/cycle-figure3.png','--base64'],input=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode(),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
print('IMAGEBASE64:'+base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode())
